rejections.name: Chemistry
rejections.reason: "Lithium" comes from the product name "WallMount Indoor 100Ah Lithium"; the specification tables have no chemistry row.

rejections.name: CELL VOLTAGE PROTECTION
rejections.reason: The CHARGE row; the DISCHARGE row prints the same name with another value, so the name alone does not say which.

rejections.name: MODULE VOLTAGE PROTECTION
rejections.reason: The CHARGE row; the DISCHARGE row prints the same name with another value, so the name alone does not say which.

rejections.name: POWER CONSUMPTION
rejections.reason: Printed "POWER CONSUMPTION (OPERATING)"; another row is "POWER CONSUMPTION (SLEEP & OFF MODE)".

rejections.name: SOC CUTOFF
rejections.reason: A recommended setting, not a rating: "| SOC CUTOFF | - | *20% |" under "RECOMMENDED SETTING", with no BMS value.
